title: [nightly/cleanup] api/security.py: named rules, short functions, one pruning helper
summary: The deployment guards (startup secret and database checks, HTTPS redirect, allowed hosts, rate limiter, traffic monitor) get named rules and short functions instead of repeated sets and loops; the longest function goes from 53 lines to 26. 143 new tests cover the file fully, and 77,000 random environments and sequences gave identical results.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/cleanup.
Three bugs found and pinned, not fixed: a padded APP_ENV skips the HTTPS redirect, the limiter and monitor never forget an IP, and heavy traffic hides a brute-force alert.
reviewFirst: _check_database_url against the old second half of validate_deployment_security.
enforce_https_if_needed still doesn't strip APP_ENV, on purpose for now.
next: Strip APP_ENV in the HTTPS redirect too.
Drop empty rate-limit and monitor buckets so memory doesn't grow.
Give the volume and brute-force alerts their own cooldowns.
